Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649973. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and to compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4649973, standard_value IS NOT NULL, and standard_relation '='. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
